findings.evidence: Contraction.lean:45 `@[simp] private theorem contractLeft_coord_basis_eq_zero_of_not_mem`, :94 `@[simp] theorem basis_singleton`, :131 `@[simp] theorem contractLeft_coord_basis`; :68 `theorem involute_basis` has no attribute.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `involute_basis`; the RHS `(-1 : R) ^ s.card • b.ExteriorAlgebra s` has no `involute` and cannot loop.
findings.issue: `involute_basis` is the coordinate computation of `involute` on an exterior-basis vector but is not `@[simp]`, while the two parallel basis computations in the same file are (`contractLeft_coord_basis` line 131, `basis_singleton` line 94). Consumers must rewrite by hand, as `involute_mem_integralLattice` does.

findings.evidence: Compare TypeB/Basic.lean:114-126 (`@[simp] typeBBasis_inl/_inr_inl/_inr_inr`), :176 `@[simp] typeBQuadraticEquiv_lie_ι`; Weight.lean:287 `@[simp] spinAction_diagonalBivector_basis`; Algebra/Lie/Orthogonal/TypeB/RootGenerators.lean:98,215,231,249 (`@[simp] coe_typeB*Generator`, `@[simp] typeBDiagonalEquiv_lie_*`).
findings.fix: Mark the six `typeBQuadraticEquiv_typeB*` lemmas `@[simp]`. None loops (each RHS drops the equiv application), and they feed the existing simp normal form: `spinAction_diagonalBivector_basis` is already `@[simp]`. Leave the two `spinAction_..._basis` corollaries unannotated, since they are the integer-explicit restatements downstream of that normal form.
findings.issue: None of the six characteristic evaluations of the comparison map carries `@[simp]`: `typeBQuadraticEquiv_typeBLongRootGenerator` (181), `..._typeBShortRootGenerator` (211), `..._typeBShortNegativeRootGenerator` (236), `..._typeBDiagonalMatrix_single` (265), `..._typeBShortCorootGenerator` (298), `..._typeBLongCorootGenerator` (313). These are the normal-form rules that reduce a named generator to `bivector`/`diagonalBivector`, and the analogous evaluation lemmas elsewhere are all simp.

summary: Surface is minimal, bodies stay hidden, and the rename leaves no compatibility artifact. The gap is automation: the new characteristic evaluation lemmas and the new exterior-basis computation carry no `@[simp]`, unlike every comparable lemma in the same files.
